_synthetic_note: No live DB deal exists for this spec. Layer 1 / Layer 2 DB checks and Layer 3 API checks are SKIPPED in the validate script; spec coherence is checked instead. Behavioral validation lives in apps/worker/src/lib/financial-facts/__tests__/synthetic-kpi-fixture.test.ts.
_coverage_rationale: REF-DEAL-6: Deck-only company (no XLSX) with a dense KPI slide and multiple pricing traps. Tests the system's ability to read a KPI-heavy deck without mistaking pricing tiers, license fees, or market-size numbers for company revenue. The fixture targets a deck with 4+ pricing mentions, a competitor comparison table, and a market size slide all on the same pages as the traction KPIs. It also exercises multi-value ARR/MRR selection: the deck contains both the true KPI values (labeled 'Total MRR' / 'Total ARR') and several larger aspirational/competitor figures — ensuring 'Total'-prefixed KPI labels win over raw mentions.
_failure_modes_targeted: Pricing trap: '$99/seat/month' becoming burn_rate or revenue via deck NLP
Pricing trap: '$499/month platform fee' captured as burn_rate via /month phrasing
Market size trap: '$4.2B TAM' promoted to revenue or ARR by a large-dollar-figure labeler
Competitor ARR trap: 'ARR $50M' from competitor slide assigned as company ARR instead of true $2.18M ARR
Channel projection trap: 'MRR of $381K projected channel MRR' beating true Total MRR of $182,400
Fundraise confusion: '$6M raise' mistaken for revenue
Unit economics: 'Revenue efficiency: 11x' should not generate any dollar metric
LTV/CAC: 'LTV $18,000' or 'CAC $2,100' should not become revenue or MRR values
_onboarding_status: PHASE-4-COMPLETE — fixture spec populated, Vitest behavioral tests passing

financials._note: Synthetic fixture: deck-only deal. No XLSX. All KPI values come from the Traction slide KPI tiles. The deck has a dense noise environment: pricing page, TAM/SAM/SOM slide, competitor comparison table, unit economics slide, and channel partner opportunity slide all on adjacent pages. True operating metrics: MRR $182,400 (Total MRR tile), ARR $2,188,800 (Total ARR tile). Selection rule: '$X Total ARR/MRR' label wins over all non-Total ARR/MRR mentions regardless of dollar size.
